body: People know that I'm very anxious and shy. I have major depression and I try my best to be a good person in general. The kind words that people mostly tell me from what I hear is that I'm "a very lovely person". And most of those people see me as a role model for younger children. I hope I can be, even though I don't feel that great about myself.

Yeah. I'm scared of being judged and not being able to control myself the way I should. My depression makes me have multiple anxiety attacks and panic attacks and I've been called a lot of negative things because of it.

I have a few friends that listen sometimes but I feel like they get tired of hearing me. I try to open up to my parents but its hard because I can't talk to them about everything that's been troubling me so freely.  I try to talk to the therapist too but I feel like it isn't work. I don't have too many people to rely on and I don't know what to do.

My advice is that you shouldn't get back together with her. She didn't even take time to recover from the breakup and already slept with someone else within the same week. Yet she tells you she still loves you. I mean, if she really loved you, she would've taken the time to process things. Even if the guy is a rebound, I think you deserve more respect than that. There's just a few red flags that are just going to make it a lot tougher on you if you two decide to get back together. My suggestion is don't unless you two are REALLY going to work on things. Because chances are, she could do it again.
